why: ສ: first letter of ສະບາຍດີ
◌ະ: makes syllable ສະ
ບ
◌າ: long aa
ຍ as a final (y): makes syllable ບາຍ
ດ
◌ີ: makes syllable ດີ
ສະບາຍດີ hello: all three syllables together
First sentence: the greeting itself
ດີ good: no new letters (last syllable of ສະບາຍດີ)
◌ໍ: aw
◌່ mai ek: first tone mark (mid tone)
ບໍ່ no / question marker
___ ບໍ່? yes/no question
ບໍ່ ___ negation
ດີບໍ່? Is it good?
ສະບາຍດີບໍ່? How are you?
ບໍ່ດີ. Not good.
ມ
ແ◌: long ae
ນ
ແມ່ນ yes / that's right
ແມ່ນບໍ່? Right?
ບໍ່ແມ່ນ. No.
ຈ
ເ◌ົາ: ao
◌້ mai tho: second tone mark
ເຈົ້າ you / polite yes
ເຈົ້າສະບາຍດີບໍ່? How are you?
ຂ
◌ອ◌: long aw before a final
ຂ້ອຍ I
ຂ້ອຍສະບາຍດີ. I'm well.
ໃ◌: ai
ໃຈ heart/mind: building block for ຂອບໃຈ
ຂອບໃຈ thank you: no new letters
ຂອບໃຈ! Thank you!
ຂ້ອຍສະບາຍດີ ຂອບໃຈ. I'm well, thank you.
ຂໍ ask for: no new letters
ທ
ໂ◌: long o
ຂໍໂທດ sorry / excuse me: built on ຂໍ
ຂໍໂທດ. Excuse me.
◌ຳ: am
ນ້ຳ water
ຂໍ ___ may I have ___
ຂໍນ້ຳ. Water, please.
ຫ
ງ
ຫ້ອງ room
ຫ້ອງນ້ຳ bathroom = room + water
ນອນ sleep: no new letters
ຫ້ອງນອນ bedroom = room + sleep
ຢ
◌ູ: long uu
ຢູ່ be at
ໃສ where: no new letters
___ ຢູ່ໃສ? where is ___?
ຫ້ອງນ້ຳຢູ່ໃສ? Where is the bathroom?
ຂໍໂທດ ຫ້ອງນ້ຳຢູ່ໃສ? Excuse me, where is the bathroom?
ຫ້ອງນອນຢູ່ໃສ? Where is the bedroom?
ເຈົ້າຢູ່ໃສ? Where are you?
ຫ້ອງເຈົ້າຢູ່ໃສ? Where is your room?
ນີ້ this / here: no new letters
ຫ້ອງນ້ຳຢູ່ນີ້. The bathroom is here.
ຫ້ອງນອນຢູ່ນີ້. The bedroom is here.
ຫ້ອງນີ້ດີ. This room is good.
ຂ້ອຍຢູ່ນີ້. I'm here.
ກ
◌ິ: short i
ກິນ eat
ເຂົ້າ rice: no new letters
ຂ້ອຍກິນເຂົ້າ. I'm eating.
ຂໍເຂົ້າ. Rice, please.
ລ
ວ as a final (w)
ແລ້ວ already
___ ແລ້ວບໍ່? have you ___ yet?
ກິນເຂົ້າແລ້ວບໍ່? Have you eaten yet?
ກິນແລ້ວ. I've eaten.
ເຈົ້ານອນແລ້ວບໍ່? Have you slept?
◌ື: long eu
ດື່ມ drink
ຂ້ອຍດື່ມນ້ຳ. I drink water.
ເຈົ້າດື່ມນ້ຳບໍ່? Do you drink water?
ຢາກ want to: no new letters
___ ຢາກ ___ want to
ຂ້ອຍຢາກກິນ I want to eat.
ຂ້ອຍຢາກດື່ມນ້ຳ. I want to drink water.
ຂ້ອຍຢາກນອນ. I want to sleep.
ມີ have: no new letters
___ ມີ ___ have
ເຈົ້າມີນ້ຳບໍ່? Do you have water?
ບໍ່ມີ. There isn't any.
ປ
ໄ◌: ai (same sound as ໃ◌)
ໄປ go
___ ໄປ ___ go to
ເຈົ້າໄປໃສ? Where are you going?
ຂ້ອຍໄປຫ້ອງນ້ຳ. I'm going to the bathroom.
ມາ come: no new letters
ມານີ້. Come here.
ຫຍ: ຫ + ຍ = high-class ny
◌ັ◌: short a before a final
ຫຍັງ what
ນີ້ແມ່ນຫຍັງ? What is this?
ເຈົ້າກິນຫຍັງ? What are you eating?
ເ◌ັ◌: short e before a final
ເປັນ be
ບໍ່ເປັນຫຍັງ. No problem.
ຂ້ອຍບໍ່ເປັນຫຍັງ. I'm OK.
ອ as a silent initial
ອາຫານ food
ອາຫານນີ້ດີ. This food is good.
ເຈົ້າມີອາຫານບໍ່? Do you have food?
ຮ: low-class h (same sound as ຫ)
ຮ້ານ shop
ຮ້ານຢູ່ໃສ? Where is the shop?
ຮ້ານນີ້ດີ. This shop is good.
ຮ້ານອາຫານ restaurant = shop + food
ຮ້ານອາຫານຢູ່ໃສ? Where is the restaurant?
ລາວ he/she: no new letters
ລາວຢູ່ໃສ? Where is he/she?
ລາວໄປຮ້ານ. She's going to the shop.
ລາວມາແລ້ວ. He has arrived.
ເຮົາ we: no new letters
ເຮົາໄປຮ້ານອາຫານ. We're going to the restaurant.
ເຮົາກິນເຂົ້າແລ້ວ. We have eaten.
ເຂົ້າໃຈ understand = ເຂົ້າ + ໃຈ
ບໍ່ເຂົ້າໃຈ. I don't understand.
ຂ້ອຍບໍ່ເຂົ້າໃຈ. I don't understand.
ເຈົ້າເຂົ້າໃຈບໍ່? Do you understand?
